_comment: Hand-maintained corrections to ingest_cards.py output. The digimoncard.io API only exposes `color` / `color2` (and `evolution_cost_2`), so tri-color cards lose their third color and any third digivolve path on ingest. This sidecar patches known cases. Schema: `{card_id: {field: value, ...}}` where any top-level cards.json field may be overridden; override values replace the ingest-produced ones outright. Applied AFTER all other ingest/backfill steps so manual corrections win. CardColor int key: Red=0, Blue=1, Yellow=2, Green=3, White=4, Black=5, Purple=6.
_note_BT11-061: BT11-061 Vemmon prints a 50-copy deck allowance ("You can include up to 50 copies of cards with this card's card number in your deck."). The digimoncard.io API drops this rule text; max_count_in_deck RAISEs the per-card copy cap. See G-DECK-COPY-LIMIT-RAISE. Applied via cards[cid].update(patch) in ingest_cards.apply_overrides.
_evo_costs_comment: BT12-022 (ExVeemon) and BT12-050 (Stingmon) have a second digivolve path that the digimoncard.io ingest dropped. DCGO BT12_022.asset / BT12_050.asset list both paths (Blue Lv.3 cost 2 + Green Lv.3 cost 2). These overrides re-establish the alt-digivolve so Imperialdramon DNA support behaves correctly.
_ad1_025_comment: AD1-025 Omnimon prints [Assembly] -6 [WarGreymon] x [MetalGarurumon] (DCGO AD1_025.cs:214-255 AddAssemblyConditionClass, reduceCost 6, elements WarGreymon x1 + MetalGarurumon x1) but the digimoncard.io ingest dropped it. This override restores the keyword on effect_description_eng (engine play behavior is driven by the assembly alt_path in cards/ad1/AD1-025.yaml). Reminder text phrased per Comprehensive Rules section 7-3; the official English parenthetical was not recoverable from a primary source.

The card face, the official Bandai DB (data/card_bundles/BT25-026.md, world.digimoncard.com) and DCGO (BT25/Blue/BT25_026.cs -> CanNotSwitchAttackTargetClass, isInheritedEffect) all print "[Your Turn] This Digimon's attack target can't change." card_data.rs parses printed keywords out of this field, so the bad text gave every Digimon inheriting from Crescemon a free extra security check (measured by the DCGO exam: BT25-026-inherited0 diffed p1.security ours=3 dcgo=4). _note_EX12-004: EX12-004 Onibimon is a Lv.2 Digi-Egg whose card face carries exactly ONE text box, an Inherited Effect. The digimoncard.io ingest put that inherited text into effect_description_eng -- prefixed with the literal label "Inherited Effect" and with the <Execute> reminder text appended -- and left inherited_effect_description_eng truncated mid-sentence at 38 characters ("This Digimon with the [TB] trait gains"). Healthy Digi-Eggs (BT1-001, BT1-002, BT1-003) have an EMPTY effect field and their text in the inherited field; this restores that shape. Text read off the card image (DCGO_Application/Assets/Textures/Card/EX12-004.webp), which is the authoritative source for printed text. Nine sibling Digi-Eggs share the same ingest defect: BT25-001..006 and EX12-001..003. See docs/RUST_ENGINE_GAPS.md#g-data-egg-inherited-text-in-effect-field.

_note_digi_egg_inherited_ingest: BT25-001..006 and EX12-001..003 are Lv.2 Digi-Eggs sharing one digimoncard.io ingest defect with EX12-004: the card's single Inherited Effect box was written into effect_description_eng, prefixed with the literal label "Inherited Effect", while inherited_effect_description_eng got a lossy copy. Healthy Digi-Eggs (BT1-001/002/003) carry an EMPTY effect field with their text in the inherited field. Each correction below was read off that card's face in DCGO_Application/Assets/Textures/Card/<ID>.webp and matches the (complete) text the ingest had misfiled into the effect field, so keyword rendering and reminder text follow the corpus's own conventions rather than being retyped. Two of the lossy inherited copies had lost real content, not just formatting: BT25-005 dropped "[Three Musketeers] in its text" from its digivolve condition, and BT25-004 rendered "[Social], [Tool] or [Game]" as "[Social|Tool|Game]". Six more had lost their leading timing tag ([Your Turn], [Opponent's Turn], [End of Your Turn]). See docs/RUST_ENGINE_GAPS.md#g-data-egg-inherited-text-in-effect-field. Source-priority nuance: BT25-001..006 have official Bandai DB bundles under data/card_bundles/, and the extractor prefers a bundle over this sidecar. For those six the inherited_effect_description_eng value here is a FALLBACK that documents the truth and would apply if the bundle went missing; the load-bearing half of their override is the empty effect_description_eng, which removes the phantom effect clause the ingest created. EX12-001..003 have no bundle, so their text here is what the extractor actually uses. The bundle renders <Draw 1> without the trailing reminder text; this sidecar keeps the reminder because that is how cards.json renders the keyword elsewhere (BT1-003, BT1-006, BT1-022).
